title: 4th Gen AMD CDNA™ Generative AI Architecture Powering AMD Instinct M350 Series GPUs and Platforms
problem: Generative AI and LLM inference require GPU architectures optimized for transformer workloads with efficient memory bandwidth, tensor operations, and mixed-precision compute.
motivation: Explosive growth in LLM inference drives demand for specialized GPU architectures delivering high throughput per watt for data center AI acceleration.
method: 4th Gen CDNA architecture enhances the previous generation with improved compute density, memory hierarchy, tensor cores, and specialized instructions for transformer operations and mixed-precision formats.
key_novelty: Optimized tensor core microarchitecture and memory subsystem specifically designed for generative AI and LLM workloads.
contributions: 4th generation CDNA GPU architecture for AI
Enhanced tensor compute units and mixed-precision support
Improved memory bandwidth and cache hierarchy
AMD Instinct M350 series GPU implementations
primary_theme: GPU for generative AI and LLM inference
